text: EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE AKURANA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death;

And whereas the Secretary of the United National Alliance, the recognized political party to which Pahala Walawwe Abdul Asis Hajju Mohidin the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(l) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon returned member of Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated the decision to nominate Mohamd Saleem Mohamd Haswer to fill such vacancy;

Therefore I, Hewage Dhanushka Naleen Sampath Fernando, Returning Officer of the Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(l) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Mohamd Saleem Mohamd Haswer, was elected as the member of the Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha. H. D. N. S. Fernando, Returning Officer, Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office,Kandy,18th of February, 2026.
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
